narrative.overview: The site is built to read like a well-run control surface rather than a brochure. Every fact about Talon's work — a role, a date, a stack, a deployment target, a platform still running in production — appears as data on a dark panel, separated from its neighbours by a 1px hairline, and marked with exactly one status color. Nothing floats, nothing glows, and nothing asks to be admired. The visitor reads a system that is already working, and the reading is the pitch. Density is high but never crowded: sections step on a fixed 80px rhythm, panels carry 24px of internal padding, and the page holds exactly two content widths. Hierarchy is carried by family, size, and weight — not by dimming. Prose runs in Inter; everything the tool would say (headings, navigation, labels, buttons, captions, values, code, even section subtitles) runs in JetBrains Mono. Depth is a line and a tonal step, never a shadow. Motion is close to absent by design: no entrance choreography, no parallax on content, no hover lift. What exists is functional — a scroll cue that bobs, an icon whose stroke draws itself on hover, and the WebGL terminal behind the hero.
keyCharacteristics: Hairline-delimited dark panels on a near-black field; zero box-shadows in flow.
One signal color (Signal Green) for status, action, and inline emphasis — never for large surfaces.
JetBrains Mono as the machine voice, Inter only for prose paragraphs.
Two content widths, one 80px vertical step, 8px radius almost everywhere.
Hover and focus are color and line events; nothing moves, scales, or lifts.
Confirmed feel: tactile and confident, reached today through committed accent fills and hairline shifts rather than motion.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Green is for status, action, and emphasis. A surface may take it at 10% alpha or less; it fills only small interactive elements and their hover states. At most one solid green fill is visible at a time.

rules.name: The Emphasis-Is-Color Rule
rules.body: Inline <strong> and <b> are Signal Green at 600 weight — that is the system's emphasis mechanism, applied globally in globals.css. Never bold text and leave it chalk.

rules.name: The Machine Voice Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono speaks for the system: headings, navigation, buttons, labels, subtitles, meta, captions, numbers, and code. Inter speaks only for prose paragraphs. Mixing the two inside one element is a defect.

rules.name: The No-Dim Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from family, size, and weight. Do not create a secondary text tone by lowering opacity or switching to a grey — the system has deliberately lost that dimension.

rules.name: The Two-Width Rule
rules.body: The page has exactly two content widths — 1024px and the projects' 1152px. A new section invents neither a third width nor its own padding scale.

rules.name: The 80px Step Rule
rules.body: Sections breathe on an 80px vertical step; only case studies escalate to 112/128px because they are read, not scanned.

rules.name: The Hairline-First Rule
rules.body: If a surface needs to read as separate from the field, give it a 1px #27272a border and a tonal step. Reach for a shadow only when the element is genuinely above the document.

rules.name: The Blur-Means-Behind Rule
rules.body: Backdrop blur marks a translucent plane with moving or scrolling content behind it. It is not a decoration for static cards.

rules.name: The 8px Rule
rules.body: Working surfaces are 8px. Pills are full. Diagram and inner sub-cards may take 4px. Nothing takes a bespoke radius.

rules.name: The Pill-For-Data Rule
rules.body: Fully round shapes are for short pieces of data — status, tool, tag, step number. Never for buttons, cards, or images.

rules.name: The Color-Event Rule
rules.body: Hover and focus change color, border, and outline — never size, position, or shadow. transition-colors/transition-all on a hover that also moves the element is a defect.

dos: Do build every working surface as 8px radius, 1px #27272a border, Panel Graphite #18181b fill, 24px padding — the recipe is the system.
Do keep JetBrains Mono for anything the system would say and Inter for prose sentences, following the Machine Voice Rule.
Do tint Signal Green surfaces at ≤10% alpha (#22c55e1a) and reserve the solid fill for the primary action's hover state.
Do express emphasis with Signal Green at 600 weight, inline, as globals.css already does for <strong>.
Do use focus-visible:outline-2 outline-accent with an offset of 2 on controls and 4 on inline links; it is uniform across the codebase and must stay that way.
Do carry structure with hairlines, tonal steps, and divider grids before considering any other device.
Do keep the page at exactly two content widths and one 80px section step.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion in every animation, including custom ones.
donts: Don't add box-shadows to in-flow surfaces. The rendered system has none; shadows belong to overlays that genuinely float.
Don't dim body copy to fake hierarchy or reach for grey text — hierarchy is family, size, and weight. The muted token is currently a broken duplicate of #e4e4e7; do not spread it further.
Don't introduce neon, emoji, sticker badges, gradient text, or decorative fake terminal chrome — the confirmed anti-reference for this world.
Don't add a second accent color, a second dark hue family, or a third content width.
Don't use fully round shapes for buttons, cards, or images; pills are for data.
Don't animate content on entry, on scroll, or on hover beyond the documented scroll cue, icon stroke, and WebGL canvas.
Don't letter-space or uppercase prose; uppercase tracking is reserved for eyebrows and diagram labels.
Don't replace the committed headshot with an illustration, silhouette, or generated stand-in.
